name: computer-control
label: Computer Control
description: Control this machine's screen, mouse, and keyboard (Anthropic computer-use action set). Each action returns a fresh screenshot so the agent can see the result.

system_requirements.notes: Linux: X11 sessions only. Wayland blocks synthetic mouse/keyboard input — the tool returns an actionable error there rather than silently doing nothing. `scrot` backstops screen capture; `xclip` enables the clipboard-paste fallback the `type` action uses for non-ASCII text. macOS: grant the satellite's host process BOTH Accessibility (synthetic input) and Screen Recording (capture) under System Settings -> Privacy & Security; while macOS Secure Input is active (some password fields) synthetic keystrokes are silently dropped. Windows: no extra packages needed, but a non-elevated satellite cannot interact with UAC prompts or windows of elevated processes.

skills.description: How to drive the screen/mouse/keyboard with the computer tool: the screenshot-first loop, the coordinate space, every action's parameters, and the platform edge cases.
